app.name: Club Manager
app.tagline: Run your esports organization: people, roles, teams and games in one place.

auth.signInLead: Use the email and password you joined with.
auth.discordHint: Discord works once you have linked it from Settings.
auth.registerLead: You will be its first Owner. Everyone else joins by invitation.
auth.organizationSlugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Used in links.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
auth.forgotLead: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we will send a reset link that works for 60 minutes.
auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.resetLead: This signs you out everywhere else.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth.resetMissingToken: This page needs the link from your reset email.
auth.signupDisabled: New organizations can't be created here right now. Ask an Owner to invite you.

invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.

errors.conflict: That name is already in use.

errors.no_active_organization: You're not in an active organization.

errors.slug_taken: That organization address is taken. Try another.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

errors.system_role_locked: The Owner role can't be changed.
errors.role_in_use: This role is still assigned or used by a pending invitation.
errors.invalid_scope: That role or scope isn't available in this organization.

errors.game_in_use: Teams use this game. Deactivate it instead.

errors.discord_already_linked: That Discord account is already linked to another user, or you already linked one.
errors.oauth_state_invalid: The Discord sign-in expired or was interrupted. Try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.fx_rate_required: No exchange rate is known for that currency and date. Enter the rate.
errors.base_currency_locked: The reporting currency can't change once costs, revenue or budgets are recorded.
errors.currency_not_enabled: That currency isn't enabled. Turn it on in Finance settings.
errors.roster_member_mismatch: That person isn't on the selected team.
errors.season_overlap: Seasons can't overlap. Adjust the dates.
errors.in_use: This is still used by other records, so it can't be deleted.
errors.export_failed: The file couldn't be generated. Try again.
errors.contract_incomplete: Some contract details are still missing.
errors.contract_not_editable: This contract can't be edited in its current state.
errors.contract_invalid_transition: That step isn't possible for this contract right now. Reload the page.
errors.self_approval_not_allowed: Someone else with approval rights must decide on your own request.
errors.no_changes_since_rejection: Revise the contract before submitting it again.
errors.required_clause: Required clauses can't be removed or left out.
errors.ai_not_configured: The assistant isn't set up yet.
errors.ai_unavailable: The assistant couldn't produce a proposal. Try again in a moment.
errors.date_of_birth_required: Add the recipient's date of birth first: it decides whether a parent or guardian must also sign.
errors.guardian_required: The recipient is under 18: add the parent or guardian's name, relationship and an email or phone.
errors.signing_in_progress: This contract is already out for signature.
errors.not_signing: This contract isn't out for signature.
errors.link_invalid: This signing link isn't valid. Check that you opened the whole link.
errors.link_expired: This signing link has expired. Ask the organization for a new one.
errors.link_revoked: This signing link has been withdrawn. Ask the organization for a new one if needed.
errors.link_used: This link has already been used to sign.
errors.link_locked: This link is locked after too many wrong codes. Ask the organization for a new link.
errors.verification_required: Confirm it's you first: request or enter your code.
errors.email_unavailable: No code can be emailed to this signer. Add an email address, or use an access code instead.
errors.not_your_turn: The recipient has to sign first.
errors.already_signed: This signature has already been given.

errors.assistant_not_allowed: You don't have access to this assistant.
errors.email_send_failed: The email couldn't be sent, so nothing was delivered. Try again later.
errors.meeting_not_editable: This meeting has been cancelled and can't be changed.
errors.version_conflict: Someone changed this meeting while you were editing. Reload it and try again.
errors.not_a_participant: Only people invited to this meeting can answer it.
errors.integration_not_configured: This integration isn't set up on the server yet.
errors.integration_unavailable: The service couldn't be reached or refused the request. Check the details and try again.
errors.url_not_allowed: Use an https address on the public internet (private and local addresses aren't allowed).
errors.id_document_required: Upload your identity document before signing.
errors.id_document_not_needed: No identity document is needed from you.

overview.ownerAccess: You are an Owner of this organization: you can see and change everything.
overview.noAccess: You don't have any permissions yet. An Owner can assign you a role.
overview.teamsVisible: {count, plural, =0 {No teams} one {# team} other {# teams}} visible to you
overview.pendingInvites: {count, plural, =0 {No pending invitations} one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
overview.noOrganization: You're not part of an active organization
overview.noOrganizationLead: Ask an Owner for an invitation, or check your suspension status with them.

teams.title: Teams
teams.lead: Each team belongs to a game and, optionally, a department. Access can be limited to single teams or departments.
teams.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Role assignments limited to this team are removed too.
teams.emptyCanCreate: Create your first team to start organizing rosters.
teams.emptyScoped: No teams are assigned to you yet.

departments.title: Departments
departments.lead: Departments group teams. Giving someone a role on a department covers all of its teams.
departments.teamCount: {count, plural, =0 {No teams} one {# team} other {# teams}}

games.title: Games
games.lead: The titles your organization competes in. Edit the list freely; deactivate a game instead of deleting it once teams use it.

members.title: Members
members.lead: Everyone in this organization and what they can access.
members.suspendLead: They are signed out immediately and can't access this organization until reactivated. Their other organizations are not affected.
members.makeOwnerConfirm: Make {name} an Owner? Owners have full control, including over other Owners.
members.editAccessLead: Each line gives one role over a scope. Their access is everything these lines allow together.

inviteForm.title: Invite someone
inviteForm.lead: They get a link to create their account and join with the access you choose here.
inviteForm.makeOwnerHint: Owners have full control of the organization.
inviteForm.emailSent: We emailed the link to {email}. You can also copy it and send it yourself.
inviteForm.emailNotSent: The email could not be sent. Copy the link and send it yourself.

scope.orgLevelNote: Organization-level permissions in this role apply organization-wide even when the role is limited to a team or department: {permissions}.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.lead: Roles are sets of permissions. Assign them to members on the whole organization, a department or a single team.
roles.nameRequired: Give the role a name in at least one language.
roles.permissionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
roles.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {Not assigned} one {Assigned once} other {Assigned # times}}
roles.lockedHint: The Owner role always has every permission and can't be edited or deleted.
roles.kindScopable: Can be limited to teams or departments
roles.ownerOnlyHint: Reserved for Owners so no one can grant themselves more access.

settings.edit: Edit organization name and default language
settings.edit_sensitive: Edit legal, tax and approval-stamp settings

members.manage: Change members' roles, suspend and reactivate

finance.view: See costs, revenue, pay and financial reports
finance.edit: Change recorded costs, revenue and pay terms
finance.configure: Set the reporting currency, currencies and seasons

contracts.view: See contracts, their versions and approval history
contracts.create: Draft new contracts and edit their own drafts
contracts.edit: Edit any draft contract in scope
contracts.manage_templates: Change contract types and clause templates
contracts.send_for_signature: Send approved contracts for signature, manage signing links and cancel signing
contracts.view_signer_id: View signers' identity documents (the passport or ID uploaded when signing)

assistants.email: Use the Email Assistant to draft emails
assistants.offer_optimizer: Use the Offer Optimizer and apply its alternatives to draft contracts they can edit
assistants.send_email: Send reviewed assistant emails from the platform

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: A permanent record of sensitive actions. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

platform.audit_viewed: Platform admin viewed the audit log

contract.clause_proposed: Asked the assistant for a clause
contract.signer_id_uploaded: Uploaded an identity document while signing

assistant.offer_applied: Applied an Offer Optimizer alternative to a contract

meeting.occurrence_cancelled: Cancelled one occurrence of a meeting
meeting.occurrence_moved: Moved one occurrence of a meeting

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

contract.fully_signed: {number} is fully signed. The signed document is ready.

integration.failed: {name} stopped syncing ({code}). Open Integrations to see why.
integration.conflict: {title} was changed in {name} and here at the same time; the platform's version was kept ({fields}).

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies on every device you sign in on.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
settings.signedOutOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in} one {Signed out # other device} other {Signed out # other devices}}
settings.discordLead: Link Discord to sign in with it instead of your password.
settings.discordNotConfigured: Discord sign-in isn't set up for this platform yet.
settings.verificationNote: Contract and electronic-signature features arrive in later phases. Before relying on contracts signed in this platform for official player registration, confirm the requirements directly with the Saudi Esports Federation or your legal counsel.

platform.title: Platform admin
platform.lead: Every organization on this platform. Viewing an organization's members is recorded in its audit log.

rateSource.provider: Rate from the exchange-rate service on that date

expense.title: Costs
expense.lead: Every cost, recorded at organization, team or player level, in its own currency.
expense.emptyLead: Record salaries, travel, bootcamps, fees and equipment to see where money goes.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.lead: Income received, and income still expected. Only received income counts in totals.
revenue.emptyLead: Record prize money, sponsorships, media share and merchandising.

ledger.deleteConfirm: This removes the record from all totals and reports. The audit log keeps a copy.
ledger.choosePlayer: Choose a person on this team.
ledger.amountHint: Digits with up to 4 decimals, for example 1250.50
ledger.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, for example 1250.50
ledger.rateInvalid: Enter a positive rate, for example 0.2667
ledger.rateManual: Using the rate you entered. It is stored with this record.
ledger.rateStored: Using the rate stored when this was recorded ({date}). Enter a rate to replace it.
ledger.rateProvider: Rate for {date} from {source}. It will be stored with this record and never change.
ledger.rateMissing: No rate is known for this date. Enter the rate to save.
ledger.realizedHint: Untick for income that is expected but not yet received. It then appears only in projections.
ledger.seasonHint: Automatic uses the season that contains the date.
ledger.taxNotice: Recorded only. No tax is calculated, and these amounts are not included in any total.
ledger.createOnly: You can record entries here, but seeing existing records needs finance view access.

report.lead: Costs against realized revenue, month by month, with break-even and scenarios. Every figure lists its inputs.
report.noAccess: You don't have access to financial reports.
report.noScopes: No reports are available to you yet.
report.monthlyLead: Realized revenue only. Expected income is listed under projections.
report.monthlyChart: Costs and realized revenue by month
report.nothingYetLead: Record costs and revenue, or widen the dates.

scenarios.resetDone: Scenario inputs reset to the calculated values.
scenarios.monthsAway: {count, plural, one {In # month} other {In # months}} (after the horizon)
scenarios.chart: Projected cumulative result for each scenario

budgets.lead: Planned spend against actual costs. People who can see a budget are notified once when it goes over plan.
budgets.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Recorded costs are not affected.
budgets.teamHint: A budget without a team covers costs across the whole organization.
budgets.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
budgets.datesInvalid: The end date must be on or after the start date.
budgets.linesHint: Optional. Each limit is tracked and alerted on separately.
budgets.emptyLead: Set a planned total for a team, tournament or season to track spending against it.
budgets.alertsNote: Budgets use the reporting currency. Costs in other currencies count at the rate stored on each cost.

settings.lead: Reporting currency, currencies in use, exchange rates and seasons.
settings.currenciesLead: All totals are shown in the reporting currency. Each record keeps its own currency and rate.
settings.baseHint: Choose it before recording anything; it can't change afterwards.
settings.baseLocked: Locked because records already exist. Changing it would change every stored conversion.
settings.fxSnapshot: Each record stores the rate for its own date, so past reports never change.
settings.fxNone: Automatic exchange rates are turned off. Enter a rate whenever a record is in another currency.
settings.seasonsLead: Costs and revenue are assigned to the season that contains their date. Seasons can't overlap.
settings.seasonLead: Records with dates in this range are assigned to it automatically.
settings.deleteSeasonConfirm: Delete {name}? Records keep their dates and are no longer assigned to a season.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.lead: Research on tournaments you might enter: dates, fees, prize pools and requirements.
tournaments.manualNotice: Entered by hand. Check the source before relying on it.
tournaments.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Tournaments linked to costs or revenue can't be deleted.
tournaments.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
tournaments.urlInvalid: Enter a web address starting with https:// or http://
tournaments.emptyLead: Add tournaments you're considering, with a link to where the information came from.

roster.deleteConfirm: Remove {name}? People with recorded costs can't be removed; mark them as left instead.
roster.noAccess: You don't have access to this team's roster.
roster.activeHint: Untick when someone leaves. Their history stays with this team.
roster.payLead: Pay is visible to people with finance access for this team.
roster.payReadOnly: Changing pay needs finance edit access for this team.
roster.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
roster.offSeasonHint: Used outside configured seasons. Leave empty if the same all year.
roster.payInvalid: Check the pay terms: amount, currency and contract dates.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.lead: Draft contracts from your templates, send them for approval and keep every version.

viewLead.drafts: Drafts and contracts sent back for changes.
viewLead.approved: Approved contracts with their stamped documents, including those out for signature.
viewLead.signed: Contracts with every required signature collected, with their signed documents.

contracts.newLead: Pick a contract type. Its template clauses are copied into the new draft.
contracts.rosterHint: Fills in the recipient's details from the roster.
contracts.search: Search by number, title or recipient

editor.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last save
editor.submitLead: Approvers are notified in the app. The contract is locked until they decide or you withdraw the request.
editor.withdrawLead: The request is closed and the contract can be edited again.
editor.cancelLead: The contract and its history are kept, but it can no longer be edited or submitted.
editor.missingLead: Fill in these details. Gaps also appear as highlighted markers in the preview.
editor.pendingBanner: Waiting for approval since {date}. Editing is locked until a decision is made or the request is withdrawn.
editor.integrityOk: Stored document checked: it matches its recorded fingerprint.
editor.integrityFailed: The stored document doesn't match its recorded fingerprint. Don't rely on it and contact support.
editor.readOnly: You can view this contract but not change it.
editor.approveLead: The approval stamp is applied and the approved document is generated from version {version}.
editor.selfApprovalNote: This is your own request. As an Owner you can approve it; it will be recorded as a self-approval.
editor.modifiedNote: {count, plural, one {# template clause was reworded} other {# template clauses were reworded}} for this contract. They are marked in the Clauses tab.
editor.excludedNote: {count, plural, one {# optional clause is left out} other {# optional clauses are left out}}.
editor.noStampNote: No approval stamp is set, so the document will say so. An Owner can add one in Document setup.
editor.rejectLead: Explain what needs to change. The requester sees your reason, and it stays in the history.
editor.awaitingBanner: Out for signature since {date}. Follow each signer in the Signatures tab.
editor.signedBanner: Fully signed on {date}. The signed PDF is the approved document followed by the signature record.

details.title: Title
details.titleHint: Leave empty to use the contract type's name.
details.minorNote: Under 18 on the start date: a parent or guardian must also sign. Add their details below.

clauses.lead: Required clauses come from the template and stay in. Optional ones can be left out. Rewording a template clause is allowed and is pointed out to the approver.
clauses.mergeHelp: Placeholders such as {example} are filled in from the contract details when the document is produced.

assistant.title: Custom Clause Assistant
assistant.caveat: The assistant drafts text for you to review. It is not legal advice and does not check whether a clause is valid or enforceable. Have a qualified lawyer review every clause before relying on the contract.
assistant.notConfigured: The assistant isn't set up for this workspace yet. An administrator needs to add an Anthropic API key to the server.
assistant.purposeHint: Describe it in your own words, in Arabic or English. Leave out personal details: the draft uses placeholders for names, dates and amounts.
assistant.saveFirst: Save your changes before adding a clause.
assistant.nothingChanges: Nothing in the contract changes until you choose “Add to contract”.

preview.lead: How the document reads now. Page breaks and PDF backgrounds appear in the PDF.
preview.unsaved: Showing the last saved version. Save to update the preview.

templates.title: Contract templates
templates.lead: Each contract type has its own ordered clause template. Changes apply to new contracts; existing contracts keep their own copy.
templates.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can change contract types and templates.
templates.sampleWording: The default wording is a starting point, not legal advice. Review it with legal counsel before use.
templates.removeLead: If any contract uses this type it is archived instead, so existing contracts keep it.
templates.noClauses: This template has no clauses yet.

settings.title: Document setup
settings.lead: Your letterhead, legal details and page layout, used for every contract document.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can change the document setup.
settings.backgroundHint: Fills the whole A4 page behind the text. Use a light design so the text stays readable.
settings.stampLead: Placed on every approved document. Only an Owner can change it.
settings.uploadHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB.
settings.backgroundUploadHint: PNG, JPEG or PDF, up to 5 MB.
settings.legalNote: The default templates and this setup don't make a contract legally valid. Confirm contract terms with legal counsel. Before relying on these contracts for official player registration, confirm the requirements directly with the Saudi Esports Federation or legal counsel.

signing.lead: Each signer gets their own link and confirms who they are with a 6-digit code before they can see the contract. They sign the approved document exactly as stamped.
signing.notApprovedYet: Signatures can be collected once the contract is approved.
signing.startLead: These people will be asked to sign, in this order:
signing.noPermission: You can follow signing here. Sending for signature needs the “Send for signature” permission.
signing.whoGuardian: Signs second, after the recipient, because the recipient is under 18
signing.cannotStart: Before sending, complete the details below in the contract. An approved contract can’t be edited, so a new contract is needed.
signing.minorNote: The recipient was under 18 on {date}, so a parent or guardian signs too, after the recipient.

linkState.locked: Link locked after too many wrong codes

signing.revokeLead: The link stops working immediately. You can create a new one afterwards.
signing.linkDialogLead: A new link replaces any earlier link for this signer.
signing.method: How the signer confirms who they are
signing.methodEmailHint: When they open the link, a 6-digit code is emailed to the address below.
signing.methodAccessHint: You get a 6-digit code to give them separately, by phone or in person, never together with the link.
signing.createdLead: Copy it now. For security it is shown only once.
signing.codeHint: Give this code to the signer through a different channel than the link.
signing.emailHint: When they open the link, a code is emailed to {email}.
signing.cancelLead: Open links stop working and the contract goes back to Approved. Signatures already given stay on record but don’t carry over to a new round.
signing.signedDocumentLead: The approved PDF, unchanged, followed by the signature record. Stored with its fingerprint.
signing.verifiedOk: Checked: it matches its recorded fingerprint.
signing.verifiedFailed: It doesn't match its recorded fingerprint. Don't rely on it and contact support.
signing.legalNote: Requirements for electronic signatures, and for a parent or guardian's consent for players under 18, can depend on the situation. Before relying on signed contracts, confirm the approach with the Saudi Esports Federation or legal counsel.

idDocument.label: Identity document
idDocument.needsPermission: Viewing it needs the “View signers' identity documents” permission.
idDocument.viewLead: Each view is recorded in the audit log. Don't download or share it unless you need to.
idDocument.pdfNote: This document is a PDF. Download it to view it.

signPage.title: Contract signature
signPage.from: {organization} has asked you to sign contract {number}.
signPage.asRecipient: You are asked to sign as the recipient.
signPage.asGuardian: You are asked to sign as parent or guardian.
signPage.private: This page is for you only. Don't forward the link or share your code.
signPage.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} s.
signPage.codeSent: Code sent to {email}. It's valid for 10 minutes.
signPage.verifyAccessLead: Enter the 6-digit access code {organization} gave you. It reaches you separately from this link.
signPage.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}} before this link locks.
signPage.reviewLead: This is the approved version. Read it in full before you sign.
signPage.waitingLead: Once the recipient has signed, you can sign here as parent or guardian. You can read the contract in the meantime.
signPage.drawHint: Sign inside the box with your mouse, finger or a stylus.
signPage.agree: I have read the whole contract and agree to the statement above.
signPage.confirmLead: Your signature is final once given and cannot be changed.
signPage.signedLead: Thank you. The other required signature is still to come; once it's in, you can download the signed contract from this link.
signPage.completedLead: Every required signature is in. Download your copy of the signed contract.
signPage.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Confirm it's you again to continue.
signPage.contactOrg: If you think this is a mistake, contact the organization that sent it.
signPage.revisitSigned: You've already signed with this link. Confirm it's you to see the status or download the signed copy.
signPage.idFirst: Upload your identity document above before you sign.

id.title: Your identity document
id.lead: Upload a clear photo or scan of your passport or national ID card before you sign.
id.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 8 MB. Make sure your name and photo are readable.
id.choose: Choose a file or take a photo
id.tooBig: This file is larger than 8 MB. Choose a smaller photo or scan.
id.badType: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
id.privacy: Only people your organization has specifically authorized can view it, and every view is recorded. It is kept separately from the contract and is never shared with AI assistants. It adds to the record of who signed; it is not an official identity check.

assistants.title: AI assistants
assistants.lead: Assistants that research, draft and compare for you. They only propose: nothing is saved, sent or changed until you choose to.

descriptions.general: Questions about esports, your teams, finances, contracts and tournaments. Answers cite where each point came from.
descriptions.formal_message: Turns your notes into a finished formal message, ready to copy.
descriptions.email: Drafts an email with recipients and a subject. You review and edit it, then copy it or send it.
descriptions.offer_optimizer: Compares your preferred terms with what the other side asked for and proposes alternatives with their cost, risk and trade-offs.
descriptions.player_analyst: Weighs performance, cost and risk for a player you're considering, as scenarios rather than predictions.

assistants.notAllowed: You don't have access to this assistant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
assistants.unknown: There's no assistant at this address.
assistants.notConfigured: This assistant isn't set up yet: the server needs an API key for the AI provider it uses. You can look around and prepare context, but replies can't be generated until then.
assistants.webSearchDisabled: Web search is switched off for this workspace, so answers use platform data and your own context only.

rules.title: How the assistants work
rules.proposalOnly: They only propose. Sending an email or saving terms to a contract always takes a separate click from you.
rules.yourData: They see only the platform data your own permissions allow, and never contact details or ID numbers.
rules.citations: Points that rest on a lookup show their sources and a confidence label. Links that didn't come from a real lookup are removed.
rules.language: Each conversation replies in Arabic or English: the language you write in, or the one you choose.
rules.log: Every lookup is recorded with who asked and when.

assistants.archivedNote: This conversation is archived. Restore it to continue.
assistants.webSearchHint: Lets the assistant look up public information. Results are cited with their links.
assistants.contextLead: Information the assistant should work from. It's treated as your information and cited as such.

placeholder.general: Ask a question, in Arabic or English
placeholder.formal_message: What should the message say? Add any details it must include.
placeholder.email: What is the email about? Add the points it must cover.
placeholder.offer_optimizer: What should the alternatives aim for? For example: keep the total under our budget.
placeholder.player_analyst: What do you want to know about this player?

assistants.workingTools: Looking things up and preparing a reply…

failure.timeout: The reply took too long and was stopped.

assistants.nothingChanges: Nothing is saved, sent or changed until you choose to.
assistants.confidenceHelp: Confirmed: supported by a cited source. Estimated: reasoned from the sources. Uncertain: not verified.
assistants.noLookups: Nothing was looked up for this reply.

flags.unknown_source_removed: A citation that didn't match anything looked up was removed.
flags.unsupported_confirmation: A point marked confirmed had no supporting source, so it's shown as uncertain.
flags.link_removed: A link that didn't come from a lookup or from you was removed.
flags.language_mismatch: Parts of the reply may not be in the requested language.
flags.guarantee_language: The answer used wording that sounds like a promise. Treat every figure as an estimate.
flags.tool_denied: Some data isn't available with your permissions, so it wasn't used.
flags.unknown_tool: The assistant asked for an action it doesn't have. Nothing was changed.
flags.web_search_unavailable: Web search wasn't available, so this answer uses platform data and your context only.

formal.note: Review and edit before using it. Nothing has been sent.

email.subject: Subject
email.confirmBody: It's sent from the platform, and replies go to {email}.
email.noSendPermission: Copy the email or open it in your mail app. Sending from the platform needs the permission to send assistant emails.
email.needContent: Add a subject and a message.

offer.calcNote: Amounts are calculated by the platform from the terms, never by the assistant. Totals assume every listed bonus is earned.
offer.applyLead: The terms are saved as a new version of the contract you choose. Its approval and signing steps still apply, and fields this alternative doesn't set stay as they are.
offer.noDrafts: There are no draft contracts you can edit.
offer.unchanged: {number} already has these terms, so nothing changed.
offer.cannotApply: Applying terms needs permission to edit draft contracts.

costNotes.salary_unknown: No salary is set, so the total can't be calculated.
costNotes.duration_unknown: No duration is set, so pay over the term can't be calculated.
costNotes.revenue_share_not_costed: The revenue share isn't included: there's no revenue figure.
costNotes.bonus_amount_unknown: Bonuses without an amount aren't included.

analyst.caveat: These are scenarios to support your decision, not predictions or guarantees.

forms.loadFromContract: Load our terms from a contract
forms.invalidTerms: Check the amounts: use digits only, for example 15000 or 15000.50.
forms.memberHint: The assistant looks up this player's details your permissions allow.
forms.profileHint: Name, game, role, age, current team, asking salary — whatever you know.
forms.evidenceHint: Paste stats, results, links or scouting notes.

toolLog.title: Assistant lookups
toolLog.lead: Every lookup an assistant made, with who asked and when. Assistants can only look things up; they can't change anything.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.lead: Team and organization meetings. Invitees confirm or decline; reminders reach everyone who hasn't declined.
meetings.formLead: Meetings are created straight away and invitations go out at once — no approval needed.
meetings.empty: No meetings in these four weeks.
meetings.emptyLead: Create one, or look at other weeks.
meetings.cancelledToast: Meeting cancelled. Everyone invited was told.

occurrence.cancelOneBody: Only {when} is cancelled; the rest of the series stays. Everyone invited is told.

cancel.title: Cancel this meeting?
cancel.body: Everyone invited is told, and every remaining occurrence is cancelled. A cancelled meeting can't be reopened.

detail.upcomingLead: A single occurrence can be cancelled without changing the series.

fields.title: Title
fields.administrativeHint: Only Owners can call these. They belong to the whole organization, not a team.
fields.firstDay: The first date's weekday is always included
fields.participantsHint: Invited people get a notification and can confirm or decline. You're added as the organizer.
fields.invitedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody invited yet} one {# person invited} other {# people invited}}
fields.remindersHint: Up to three. Sent as notifications to everyone who hasn't declined.

recurrenceText.monthly: {interval, plural, one {Every month} other {Every # months}} on day {day}

reminderLabels.days: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before

validation.duration_range: A meeting lasts between 5 minutes and 24 hours.
validation.start_not_on_weekday: The first date must fall on one of the chosen days.
validation.until_before_start: The last date can't be before the first.
validation.until_too_far: A series can run for up to 3 years.
validation.series_too_long: A series can run for up to 3 years.
validation.unknown_participant: Someone on the list is no longer an active member.
validation.team_or_department: Choose a team or a department, not both.
validation.administrative_is_org_wide: Administrative meetings belong to the whole organization.
validation.not_an_occurrence: That occurrence isn't part of this meeting.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lead: Connect your calendar, Notion, Obsidian and webhooks. Meetings sync both ways unless you choose push only.
integrations.personalLead: Only the meetings you're invited to. Nobody else can see or change these connections.
integrations.organizationLead: Managed by people with the integrations permission. Each acts with the permissions of the person who set it up.
integrations.noOrgConnectionsLead: Connect a Notion database, or add a webhook.
integrations.conflictRule: When a meeting changes in two places before they sync, changes to different fields are combined; if the same field changed in both, the platform's version is kept, written back, logged, and the connection's owner is notified.

descriptions.google_calendar: Your meetings in your own Google Calendar. Changes to the title, time and repeat settings come back; deleting an invitation declines it.
descriptions.notion: Meetings as pages in a Notion database: title, time, status, purpose and notes sync both ways.
descriptions.obsidian: Your meetings as notes in your Obsidian vault, through a small script on your computer (Obsidian has no online API).
descriptions.webhook_outgoing: Sends signed meeting events to another system as they happen.
descriptions.webhook_incoming: Lets another system create, change or cancel meetings with signed requests.

integrations.linked: {count, plural, =0 {no meetings linked} one {# meeting linked} other {# meetings linked}}
integrations.disconnectBody: Syncing stops and its secrets are deleted. Events and pages already created elsewhere are left as they are.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.secretOnce: It won't be shown again. If you lose it, create a new one.

google.notConfigured: Google Calendar isn't set up on this server yet (it needs a Google OAuth app — see the deployment notes).
google.primaryHint: Only meetings from the platform are synced; your other events stay private and are never imported.
google.dedicatedHint: Events you create in this calendar become meetings too (in the team you choose).
google.connected: Google Calendar connected. Your meetings will appear shortly.
google.denied: Google Calendar wasn't connected: access was not granted.

notion.connectLead: Create an internal integration at notion.so/my-integrations, share the database with it, then paste its secret and the database link here.
notion.databaseHint: Missing properties (When, Status, Purpose, Notes…) are added for you.
notion.timeZoneHint: Used for dates entered in Notion without a time zone.
notion.webhookUrl: Webhook URL (paste it into the integration's Webhooks tab in Notion)
notion.verificationToken: Verification token (paste it into Notion to finish)
notion.waiting: Waiting for Notion's verification request. Until then, changes in Notion are picked up every few minutes.

obsidian.explain: Create a vault-sync token, then run the companion script on the computer with your vault. It writes your meetings as notes in a Meetings folder and, in two-way mode, sends back what you edit.
obsidian.howTo: On the computer with your vault, download scripts/obsidian-vault-sync.mjs from the platform repository and run:
obsidian.howToHint: It needs Node.js 18 or newer. Edit the title property and the Purpose and Notes sections; if an edit can't be applied, your version is kept next to the note as a conflict copy.

webhooks.urlHint: Must be https and reachable on the public internet.
webhooks.signingHint: Requests are signed with Standard Webhooks headers (webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature). Unsigned, stale or replayed requests are refused.
webhooks.incomingActsAs: Requests act with your permissions. If you lose them, the webhook stops working.

eventCodes.remote_change_rejected: A change there was not applied
eventCodes.unsupported_recurrence: A repeat rule the platform can't use
